generalQuestions.question: How do I contact customer support?
generalQuestions.answer: You can contact our customer support team through this contact form, or email us directly at support@example.com. We aim to respond within 24 hours.

generalQuestions.question: What information should I include in my message?
generalQuestions.answer: Please include relevant details about your inquiry, such as any error messages, steps to reproduce issues, or specific questions you have. The more details you provide, the better we can assist you.

generalQuestions.question: Do you offer phone support?
generalQuestions.answer: Currently, we primarily provide support through email and this contact form. This allows us to track and resolve your issues more effectively.

generalQuestions.question: What are your support hours?
generalQuestions.answer: Our support team is available Monday through Friday, 9 AM to 6 PM EST. Messages received outside these hours will be addressed the next business day.

generalQuestions.question: How long does it take to get a response?
generalQuestions.answer: We typically respond to all inquiries within 24 business hours. Complex technical issues may require additional time for investigation.

generalQuestions.question: How do I report a bug?
generalQuestions.answer: When reporting a bug, please include: steps to reproduce the issue, expected behavior, actual behavior, and any error messages you receive. Screenshots are also helpful.

generalQuestions.question: Is my information secure?
generalQuestions.answer: Yes, we take data security seriously. All communications through this contact form are encrypted and stored securely. We never share your information with third parties.

subscriptionQuestions.question: What payment methods do you accept?
subscriptionQuestions.answer: We accept all major credit cards (Visa, MasterCard, American Express), PayPal, and bank transfers. All payments are processed securely through our payment providers.

subscriptionQuestions.question: How do I update my billing information?
subscriptionQuestions.answer: You can update your billing information by logging into your account, navigating to Settings > Billing, and selecting 'Update Payment Method'. Changes will take effect immediately.

subscriptionQuestions.question: Can I cancel my subscription at any time?
subscriptionQuestions.answer: Yes, you can cancel your subscription at any time through your account settings. Your access will continue until the end of your current billing period. No refunds are provided for partial months.

subscriptionQuestions.question: How often will I be billed?
subscriptionQuestions.answer: Billing occurs monthly or annually, depending on the subscription plan you choose. The billing date is set to the day you initially subscribed.

subscriptionQuestions.question: Do you offer refunds?
subscriptionQuestions.answer: We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee for new subscriptions. After this period, refunds are handled on a case-by-case basis. Please contact our support team to discuss your situation.

subscriptionQuestions.question: What happens if my payment fails?
subscriptionQuestions.answer: If a payment fails, we'll automatically retry the charge and notify you by email. Your account access continues during a 7-day grace period while we resolve any payment issues.

subscriptionQuestions.question: How do I get a copy of my invoices?
subscriptionQuestions.answer: All invoices are automatically emailed to you and can also be accessed through your account dashboard under Billing > Invoice History.
